panel.bin_missing: {bin} is not installed. Install it to use this plugin.
panel.gitlab_scope_missing: Set a Repository or Group in settings to view your items.
panel.no_tabs: Every tab is hidden. Enable one in the plugin settings.
panel.title: Git Companion

service.gitlab_scope_missing: GitLab requires a repo or group scope in settings.
service.title: Git Companion

bar_display_mode.description: Choose what text to show next to the icon in the bar.
bar_display_mode.label: Bar Display Mode

branch_badge.description: Choose which target branch to display in a colored badge. (Github not supported)

count_reviews_with_prs.description: Add reviews to the PR/MR count in the bar. The tooltip always lists both.
count_reviews_with_prs.label: Count Code Reviews with PRs/MRs

group.description: Filter by group (GitLab) or owner (GitHub). Leave empty to use repo.
group.label: Group / Owner

refresh_interval.description: How often to fetch updates from the API.
refresh_interval.label: Refresh Interval (seconds)

repo.description: e.g. owner/repo (GitHub) or project path (GitLab). Leave empty to use group/owner.
repo.label: Repository

show_issues.description: Show the tab listing the issues assigned to you.
show_issues.label: Show Issues tab

show_prs.description: Show the tab listing the pull/merge requests you authored.
show_prs.label: Show PRs/MRs tab

show_reviews.description: Show the tab listing open pull/merge requests awaiting your review.
show_reviews.label: Show Code Review tab
